patch_description: Replace the 3-rotation-layer + chain-CZ design with a 2-rotation-layer (RY+RZ) + brick-wall ring CZ design. This removes the redundant post-CZ RZ layer (redundancy arises because with N_REPEATS=2, the next block's RY+RZ already provides full rotation after CZ). The brick-wall CZ creates a ring topology in just 2 parallel layers instead of 7 sequential steps, significantly reducing depth. Parameters drop from 24→16 per block (146→98 total), gates from 31→24 per block, and depth per block from ~10→4. The design maintains full expressibility through the Euler-angle-complete RY+RZ rotation and ring entanglement topology.
